description:

Old friend Hurley stumbles into the path of a Mark out for vengeance on the crew; he must take point on one of the most delicate parts of the con the Cool Off; despite the crew's help, the situation spins out of control.

title: Leverage: Redemption
description:
S03 E09 — The Polygeist Job
The crew pulls a con to take down a corrupt tech guru claiming to better the world using effective altruism; they target his company's close-knit group of executives, but things get complicated when the group turns out to be much closer.

title: The Librarians: The Next Chapter
description:
S01 E11 — And the Graffiti of the Gods
Graffiti starts coming to life and threatening a teenage girl; the team must figure out how these strange events relate to Gregor's Hammer and Gregor's imminent return.

title: The Librarians: The Next Chapter
description:
S01 E12 — And the Unfinished Business
General Gregor retrieves the Sword of Mars and uses it to take over the country of Caucasylvia, gaining control of their nuclear arsenal; the team must steal the Sword to prevent world calamity.

description:

The arrival of a third ace convinces Ed the cards are his true calling, something that alienates his friends and puts all his relationships at risk.

description: Unlikely adventurer Flynn Carsen sets out to protect a precious chalice from vampire Prince Vlad Dracul.

title: The Librarians
description:
S03 E07 — And the Curse of Cindy
Cindy Kroger suddenly becomes popular thanks to a magical love potion; the librarians must stop Cindy before she launches a love missile that would force the entire world to become her fan base.

title: The Librarians
description:
S03 E08 — And the Eternal Question
The librarians are led to a holistic spa that is run by vampires when a rash of people spontaneously combust.

title: The Librarians
description:
S03 E09 — And the Fatal Separation
The balance of the universe is put in jeopardy when the Monkey King's sacred homeland of Shangri-La is taken over by a ruthless collector of magical artifacts.

title: The Librarians
description:
S03 E10 — And the Wrath of Chaos
The library is simultaneously infiltrated by DOSA and Apep; Flynn, Baird, Stone, Cassandra, Ezekiel and Jenkins must put aside their differences to save the library, the world and themselves.

title: The Librarians
description:
S04 E01 — And the Dark Secret
A secret sect of the Vatican Church unearths a map detailing the locations of the four cornerstones of the Library of Alexandria; Flynn and the Librarians work with an unexpected ally to stop them before the stones can be used to destroy the Library.

title: The Librarians
description:
S04 E02 — And the Steal of Fortune
When people begin getting hurt in the unluckiest of ways, the Librarians follow the trail to a casino where the owner appears to possess an artifact capable of stealing people's luck.

title: The Librarians
description:
S04 E03 — And the Christmas Thief
Santa takes Flynn, Baird and Jenkins on his first vacation in centuries; the Librarians use Santa's sleigh to save Ezekiel's career-criminal mother, as well as Christmas itself, from Santa's grinch of a brother, the Patron Saint of Thieves.

title: The Librarians
description:
S04 E04 — And the Silver Screen
Drawn into the world of Baird's favorite film noir movie, the Librarians must perfect their skills in lassoing, sharpshooting and snappy dialogue to make it out alive.

title: The Librarians
description:
S04 E05 — And the Bleeding Crown
Flynn is excited to team up with his Librarian hero, Darrington Dare, to take down an ancient and powerful enemy let loose in the modern day; Darrington leaves the Librarians with a dire warning that there can only be one Librarian.

title: The Librarians
description:
S04 E06 — And the Grave of Time
When Baird goes after Nicole Noone in an attempt to repair her rift with the Library, she winds up joining Nicole on a mission to retrieve a dangerous artifact before it falls into the hands of Russian grave robbers.

The team enters the world of master car thieves in order to take down a crooked car dealer.

description:

The team realizes that they each tried to steal the same artifact on the same night five years ago.

description:

description:

description:

description:
S03 E15 — The Big Bang Job
The team infiltrates a government research lab to stop Damien Moreau from auctioning information to international terrorists.

title: Leverage
description:

After following Moreau to San Lorenzo, the team discovers that he is the chief advisor to the current President.

description:

The team must recover lost evidence from a mountain while battling hired guns and bad weather.

title: Leverage
description:
S04 E02 — The 10 Li'l Grifters Job
When a mark is killed during a sting, the team races to complete the con and find the killer.

title: Leverage
description:
S04 E03 — The 15 Minutes Job
The team attempts to take down a corrupt PR consultant by using his own methods against him.

title: Leverage
description:
S04 E04 — The Van Gogh Job
While tracking a Van Gogh painting, the team learns the painting was the center of a World War II love story.

title: Leverage
description:
S04 E05 — The Hot Potato Job
The team infiltrates a corrupt group involved in corporate agriculture to recover a stolen object.

title: Leverage
description:
S04 E06 — The Carnival Job
While the team infiltrates a high-tech home to steal a computer chip, the family's child is abducted from a carnival.

title: Leverage
description:
S04 E07 — The Grave Danger Job
The crew sets its sites on a funeral director who embezzles money from grieving patrons.

title: Leverage
description:
S04 E08 — The Boiler Room Job
The team goes up against a con man from a long lineage of greats.

title: Leverage
description:
S04 E09 — The Cross My Heart Job
The team tries to retrieve a stolen heart intended for a 15-year-old patient.

title: Leverage
description:
S04 E10 — The Queen's Gambit Job
Sterling convinces the team to steal a calibration weight for a nuclear reactor during an international chess tournament.

title: Leverage
description:
S04 E11 — The Experimental Job
The team must infiltrate the world of secret societies when homeless veterans in the Boston area begin to disappear.

title: Leverage
description:
S04 E12 — The Office Job
While trying to uncover an embezzlement scam, the team becomes part of a documentary shooting at the company they are trying to save.

title: Leverage
description:
S04 E13 — The Girls' Night Out Job
When a thief targets Parker's friend, Parker, Sophie and Tara track the thief to the Venezuelan Consulate.

title: Leverage: Redemption
description:
S01 E02 — The Panamanian Monkey Job
With a new team member on board, plus the arrival of Hardison's genius foster sister, the team heads to Panama to pull an elaborate heist before an evil billionaire can get his money and flee to a non-extradition country.
